components.note: 月 (moon, month) — time and the moon: 明 bright, 朗 clear; in 期 it is a set period, as in 星期 week.
其 (qí) is the same sound with a different tone; also in 旗 qí, 棋 qí, 欺 qī.
气 (air, vapor) — lines of rising vapor or breath. Add water for 汽 steam; seen in 生气 get angry, 空气 air.
廴 (long stride) — a rare radical of walking and extending, also in 延 yán and 廷 tíng; 建 means to set up or put up; the sound clue 聿 is only loose.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and language: 说 say, 请 ask, 话 speech; 议 is to discuss.
义 (yì) sounds exactly like 议; same part in 仪 yí and 蚁 yǐ.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 作. 做 is a later variant of 作 zuò (to do), sharing its meaning and sound.
故 (gù) is only a loose sound hint.
尸 (body, rump) — body-related words: 尿 urine, 屎 dung, 尾 tail, 屋 room; here the buttocks and what comes out.
比 (bǐ) is only a loose sound hint for pì.
⺼ (flesh, form of 月) — body parts: 腿 leg, 脚 foot, 肚 belly; 股 is the thigh or rump, later a share.
殳 (shū, weapon in hand) — only a loose sound hint; it also appears in 投 and 设.
日 (sun, day) — a picture of the sun, once round with a dot, now squared off. As a radical it marks light and time: 明, 晴, 时.
刂 (knife) — cutting and sharp edges: 利 sharp, 刻 carve, 别 divide; 则 meant rules engraved to last. 贝 here is simplified from old 鼎.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — arranging and moving by hand: 打, 推, 拉; 排 is to line things up.
非 (fēi) is a loose sound hint; its series includes 悲 bēi and 菲 fēi.
年 (year) — first drawn as a person carrying harvested grain: one harvest per year. Seen in 今年, 去年, 年轻.
车 (cart, simplified 車) — vehicles and transport: 转 turn, 输 transport, 较 compare; 轻 was a light cart.
The right half is a short form of 巠 (jīng), the sound part in 经 jīng, 径 jìng and 茎 jīng — a loose clue for qīng.
女 (woman) — female kin and women: 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 妹 younger sister, 娘; 姑 is a father's sister.
古 (gǔ) is close to gū; the series includes 估 gū, 枯 kū, 苦 kǔ and 故 gù.
女 (woman) — mothers and girls: 妈, 姑, 姐; 娘 is mother or young woman, as in 新娘 bride.
良 (liáng) is a loose sound hint (-iang); same part in 狼 láng and 浪 làng.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metals and metal tools: 钱 money, 铁 iron, 针 needle; a key is made of metal.
月 (yuè) is close to yuè/yào.
匕 (spoon) — a rare radical meaning ladle or spoon; here 匙 chí is a spoon and in 钥匙 it is read neutral shi.
是 (shì) is a rough sound clue for chí/shi.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 推; 投 is to throw.
殳 (shū) is a weapon-in-hand part that is only a loose sound clue; it also appears in 设 shè and 段 duàn.
票 (ticket) — originally flames flying up, which is why 票 gives the sound piào/piāo to 漂 and 飘 and biāo to 标; ticket is a later meaning.
可 (kě) doubled — a loose sound hint for gē. The same 哥 sounds out 歌 gē (song).
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 推; 撒 is scattering or letting go.
散 (sàn) scatter is the meaning-sound part: a hand 扌 scattering, with sā/sàn close in sound.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and language: 说, 话, 请; 谎 is a spoken lie.
荒 (huāng) sounds the same as 谎 huǎng except for tone; also 慌 huāng.
止 (foot) — a foot stepping forward with a weapon 戈 (spear-axe): marching armed, hence military; seen in 武器 weapon.
Four mouths 口 (vessels) with a dog 犬 guarding them — the traditional explanation; 器 is any vessel or tool, as in 武器 and 机器.
疒 (illness, 病字旁) — illness and pain: 病 ill, 疼 ache, 瘦 thin, 疯 mad; 痛 is pain.
甬 (yǒng) is a loose sound clue; same part in 通 tōng and 桶 tǒng.
艹 (grass, plants) — plants and herbs: 花 flower, 草 grass, 茶 tea; 苦 first named a bitter herb.
古 (gǔ) is a loose clue for kǔ — see also 枯 kū and 姑 gū.
心 (heart) — feelings and thinking: 想 think, 思, 感 feel, 忙; forgetting is a loss of the heart's hold.
亡 (wáng, lose) gives the sound and fits the sense: to lose from the mind.
子 (child) — children and offspring: 孩 child, 学 study, 孙 grandchild; 存 means to keep or survive.
才 (cái) is only a loose sound hint for cún.
首 (head, first) — a picture of a head with hair on top, which became the word for first and chief: 首先, 元首, also a measure for songs.
及 (reach) — a hand 又 catching up with a person from behind: to reach, then and; seen in 以及, 及时.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and roles: 你, 他, 位; 代 is one person replacing another, then a generation.
弋 (yì) is only a loose hint; 代 itself sounds out 袋 dài and 贷 dài.
土 (earth) — ground and land: 地, 场, 城; hard like packed earth. Top part simplifies 臤 (hard), also in 紧 jǐn and 贤 xián.
义 (justice, meaning) also lends its sound to 议 yì discuss, 仪 yí ceremony and 蚁 yǐ ant — a useful clue in many characters.
言 (speech) — the traditional form of 讠: words and speech; an oath is a spoken promise.
折 (zhé, to break) — a promise you must not break; zhé is only a loose sound hint for shì.
日 (sun) — light and brightness: 明, 晴, 时; 显 is something lit up and clear to see.
攵 (tap, hand with stick) — acts that direct others: 教 teach, 放 release, 改 change, 收 collect; 政 is governing.
正 (zhèng) is the same sound; fits the sense too — government puts things right.
广 (building, shelter) — houses and large structures: 店 shop, 库 store, 度, 座; 府 is an official residence.
付 (fù) is close to fǔ; also 附 fù and 符 fú.
欠 (open mouth, lack) — yawning, breathing and wanting: 歌 song, 欢 joy, 吹 blow; 次 also sounds out 资 zī and 瓷 cí.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过 pass, 进 enter, 送 send; to meet is to cross paths.
禺 (yú) is close to yù; same part in 愚 yú and 偶 ǒu.
卩 (kneeling person) — a person kneeling at food 皀, about to eat: right at hand, immediately; compare 既, who has already eaten.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and roles: 你, 他, 位; 使 is sending someone to do something.
吏 (lì, official) gives the meaning, and shares its ancestor 史 (shǐ), the exact sound of 使.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 运 is to move, then to be moved by luck.
云 (yún) is a near sound match for yùn.
犭 (beast, form of 犬 dog) — animals: 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 狼 wolf; 犯 is to attack or violate, hence offend.
罒 (net, form of 网) — nets and entrapment: 罗 net, 罚 punish, 骂 scold; here a net of wrongdoing 非 catching the guilty.
非 (not, wrong) — what is wrong or unlawful; in 罪 it is the wrongdoing caught in the net.
⻊ (foot, form of 足) — feet and walking: 跑 run, 踢 kick, 路 road, 跟 follow; 跳 is a jump.
兆 (zhào) is a loose hint; the series 桃 táo, 逃 táo, 挑 tiāo, 眺 tiào shares the -ao sound.
舛 (two opposed feet) — the dancer's footwork; 無 (wú) above is a loose sound clue, as it once meant dance itself.
疒 (illness, 病字旁) — illness: 病, 疼, 瘦; 痴 is a sickness of the mind, hence foolish or obsessed.
知 (zhī) is a loose sound hint for chī.
耳 (ear) — hearing: 听 listen, 聋 deaf, 聪 clever; 闻 is to hear, then news.
门 (mén) is a near sound match (wén); also in 问 wèn ask.
